I don't see people here...\nDon't tell me they were killed by monsters...
Hey, wait.\nCan I ask what's going on here?
Hey, wait!
Heh, heh. Gotcha.\nBe prepared...
Take your hands off her, you monster!
W-W-What?!\nA man with beast ears?!\nYou are... Catura tribe?
Hm? ...Oh, right.\nYou haven't heard of it.
Long time ago, there used to be a place called\nthe Dark Continent in the north. And\nthere were 4 tribes: Neems, Catura, Paula, Diva.
The 4 tribes in the southern world and the\nDark Continent developed their own original\ncivilizations but...
One day, an incident that may have destroyed the\nworld occurred in the Dark Continent.\nWhen the incident was settled,
The two civilizations began to interact with\neach other. And the tribes of the same origin\ncame together like Neems and Hume, Paula and Cule,
Diva and Elf...
...But there was a big difference between Catura\nand Diel.\nDiel tribe doesn't have male.
So, they couldn't get along with each other\nand few Catura people went out from the Dark\nContinent...
When the Cataclysm occurred, the Dark Continent\nwent missing.
And nobody knew what had happened to Catura\ntribe after that...
Waaahhh!!
You! How did you get in here?!
This place is isolated from other worlds...\nOnly Catura people and monsters exist here.
And you were attacking the girl!\nYou look like a human but you must be a monster!\nShow yourself!!
Koa, stop it.\nThey are not monsters.\nThey are real humans...
I thank the god for sending you...
I apologize for what he has done.\nMy name is Anela.\nAs she said, I'm a Catura .
I'm governing this city-state with the help of\nKoa, the chief soldier and a small number of\npeople here...
Governing...\nWell, you look like a queen.\nIs that correct?
I feel embarrassed but yes...
By the way, you didn't come here of your own\nfree will, did you?
I knew it.
You must be feeling unsafe.\nI'll tell you about this town if you'd like.
Where is this town located?
Are you the only people here?
Who's that girl?
I don't see many monsters here, why?
I don't have questions.
When the Cataclysm attacked the continent where\nour ancestors lived, they were saved by the\ngreat god's protection...
But the continent almost collapsed, so the god\ntransferred the people to the world in another\ndimension, here.
That means... This world is totally different\nfrom our world?!
Right. According to the people who once tried\nto go back to the original world and returned\nafter escaping by the skin of their teeth,
this boundless looking continent does have an end\nand once they got there, there was nothing\nbut deep darkness...
Yes...
The great god said that he would pick up the\npeople after restoring the continent but...\nHe hasn't returned here yet...
...The people dreaming of returning to the\noriginal world survived for long periods of time,\nbut the number has sharply decreased these days...
As the number of strange monsters are increasing\ntoo, now we, the Catura tribe living in Akaku,\nare the only inhabitants...
When she was young, she was attacked by monsters\nand lost her parents and her hearing.
Because of that, she became sensitive and\ncan detect monsters nearby...
She must have been confused to see unfamiliar\nbeings that are not monsters.
Because mostly, unfamiliar beings around here are\nmonsters...
Hey...
Oh, I'm sorry...
I kinda get too excited when it comes to chasing.\nSorry for scaring you...
Indeed.\nI was wondering why they don't get in here.
It's because the great god's protection is here.
Great god?\nYou said it earlier but... Who?
The god who saved our ancestors from the\nCataclysm. And his divine power is protecting\nthis town even now...
Even now??
Oops, sorry for talking too much.\nI would like to show you something.\nPlease follow me.
This is the great god...
H-H-He's Almas!
It proves that the continent you were talkin'\nabout is the Dark Continent and you guys are\nthe missing Catura tribe.
It's a great discovery.\nHeh heh.\nI can fetch much money from the archaeologists...
The statue holds something similar to the\nPremiere Gem in the Ruined Temple.\nSurprising to see it here...
Are you curious about the stone?\nThe stone is emitting the great god's energy.
Thanks to the stone, the town is secured from\nmonsters for now...
What?
I know.\nDon't pick the gem, right?
I don't wanna get chased by monsters anymore.\nI won't steal it!
What happened?
What?
Monsters appeared beyond the wall.\nKoa rushed out to fight but they took him!
What?!
Oh god!\nWhat should I do...
The girl put a red flower on your chest.
Our ancestors brought the seeds of the flowers\nand grew them from generation to generation.\nIt's the flower to honor the brave.
We would like to appreciate your help again.\nThank you for saving us...
Well, at least it's settled for the time being!
This town and its surrounding world exist in a\ndifferent dimension and they are forgotten.\nI guess it'll perish just like this...
No...
And the monster's last word...
It said if the humans in this world didn't turn\ninto monsters suddenly, but they did because of\nsomeone else's deed,
this town will forever be exposed to the\nunknown threat.
Oh!\nThat's right!!
If you guys stay here, we don't need to be\nafraid of monsters any more.
Please! Could you stay in this town and fight\nagainst monsters with us?!
I'd personally like to ask the same thing but...\nThey have important things to do.\nLet's just see them off with a smile.
Even after she said so, I'll keep you here\nno matter what!
Sorry!
W-What?!
Cannot go to another map during the event!
Let's chase the girl!!
You lost sight of the girl...
